title: Electromagnetism I
purpose: Solve electrostatic and magnetostatic boundary problems and justify boundary conditions.

blocks.deliverable: Derive a potential and check its field.
State boundary data and verify a uniqueness argument.
Solve one grounded conductor problem with a justified method.
Week 7 midterm; calculate a leading far field term.
Compare a direct field integral with a potential calculation.
Check an energy expression and its assumptions.
Report numerical error and complete an unseen E and M final.

project: Solve a bounded electrostatic problem and compare an analytic solution with a numerical grid.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
